 seen=set()
 while not done.wait(.1):
  log=out/'playback.log'
  if not log.exists():continue
  for line in log.read_text(errors='replace').splitlines():
   if 'YL_RESOURCE_SERIES=' not in line:continue
   try:row=json.loads(line.split('YL_RESOURCE_SERIES=',1)[1])
   except ValueError:continue
   n=row['attempt']
   if n not in (5,) or n in seen:continue
   seen.add(n);r=dict(attempt=n,pid=row['pid'],hostStartedNs=time.monotonic_ns(),status='unavailable')
   try:
    exe=subprocess.check_output(['/bin/ps','-p',str(row['pid']),'-o','comm='],text=True,timeout=2).strip()
    expected=str(root/'packages/yl_player/example/build/macos/Build/Products/Profile/yl_player_example.app/Contents/MacOS/yl_player_example')
    if exe!=expected:raise ValueError('Owned executable mismatch')
    with (out/f'vmmap-{n}.txt').open('w') as f:
     p=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/vmmap','-summary',str(row['pid'])],stdout=f,stderr=f,timeout=10)
    r.update(status='captured' if p.returncode==0 else 'failed',exitCode=p.returncode)
    with (out/'large-allocation-history.txt').open('w') as f:
     history=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/malloc_history',str(row['pid']),'-callTree','-highWaterMark','-noContent','malloc[7m-9m]'],stdout=f,stderr=f,timeout=15)
    r['historyExitCode']=history.returncode
   except Exception as e:r['errorType']=type(e).__name__
   r['hostEndedNs']=time.monotonic_ns();records.append(r)
   (out/'category-probes.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n')
t=threading.Thread(target=monitor,daemon=True);t.start()
try:ok=collect(out,'/private/tmp/yl-memory-categories/flutter-stacks.py',profile_cycles=True,harness_only=True)
finally:done.set();t.join(12)
print('collected',ok,'category probes',records)
